periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation at approximately 45 degrees relative to the muzzle-nose axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a visual height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.8:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward elongation and tapering toward the medial-inferior quadrant near the snout.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, broadly rounded U-shape across the posterior margin of the band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band occupies approximately 35-40 percent of the visible longitudinal torso span.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly convex and rounded curvature at the distal tip of the visible ear.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent area of pinkish skin and possible alopecia visible at the anterior base of the lower ear and extending toward the oral region.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellowish-brown chromatic shift and staining across the ventral and posterior white fur regions.
